product_one_liner.value: Syren provides enterprise data and AI adoption services and solutions—including agentic AI, data engineering, and migration—to businesses, with a focus on industries such as retail and CPG.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes Syren as a last-mile partner for enterprise Data & AI adoption and names these services and sectors.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage footer/navigation includes no pricing link; no public pricing page is presented.

named_customers.notes: The case-study index describes organizations generically (for example, a beverage leader, pharma leader, and gaming company) and does not name two customers.

employee_band.notes: The available headcount sources conflict and indicate different counts or ranges (for example, 280, 383, 551, and 501–1,000); no supported count fits the requested bands consistently.

hq_location.notes: The company's license agreement states Bellevue, Washington, United States as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company license agreement states the company was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index features thought leadership, product/solution content, and implementation guidance; it does not establish at least two posts about how the product is built by engineers.

public_docs.notes: Homepage navigation/footer lists company, blog, case study, and legal resources, but no public product docs, help center, or developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Careers page has a job-portal link but its visible content does not list current job titles, and no verifiable live job board posting was available to evaluate.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed company materials name Azure as a subprocessor but do not specify which AI model or model provider the product uses.

compliance_certs.notes: The DPA explicitly states ISO 27001:2013 certification. GDPR is also named in the document, but is a regulation rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Search did not establish a funding round or affirmatively establish that the company has no outside funding.

raised_18mo.notes: No funding history sufficient to establish whether a round occurred in the specified period was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page says it is looking for talent and links to an external job portal, but current openings and titles were not available to verify.

launched_6mo.notes: Syren's July 2, 2026 post describes its TrueTrack real-time order visibility portal, a product launch within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A complete current leadership/team roster or dated evidence for changes within the window was not verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No readable job post, product documentation, or integration page naming Syren's CRM or sales/marketing system was found.
